name: telehealth requested as follow-up with verification and slot lookup
input: Hi, this is Jordan Lee, DOB 1991-04-12. I’d like to schedule a telehealth follow-up sometime next week.
grading_criteria: The agent must: (1) call lookup_patient using the full name and DOB the user provided before discussing or booking any appointment; (2) treat the result as an existing patient and not as a new patient; (3) recognize that the requested visit is a telehealth follow-up and therefore must use visitType "telehealth_follow_up" when calling find_open_slots; (4) use an appropriate next-week date range in find_open_slots with location set to "any"; (5) not attempt to book an appointment yet in this turn, but instead reply with 2–3 specific telehealth slots taken from the find_open_slots results and ask Jordan which one they prefer; (6) keep the reply short, friendly, and without mentioning tools or system details.

checks.verified_with_lookup: Did the agent call lookup_patient with Jordan Lee and 1991-04-12 before discussing appointment details?
checks.used_telehealth_visit_type: Did the agent call find_open_slots with visitType set to "telehealth_follow_up" rather than any other visit type?
checks.no_booking_yet: Did the agent avoid calling book_appointment in this turn and instead just offer specific telehealth times to choose from?
checks.offered_real_slots: Did the agent only offer times that exactly match the find_open_slots results?
